methodology: The Telangana Green Action Score measures mapped action opportunities surfaced by a photo; it is not an environmental performance or impact rating. COCO object presence does not establish lifecycle emissions, materials, recyclability, or energy use. User-confirmed supported classes may retrieve related articles from the private knowledge base.
limitations: COCO classes are object names, not material composition.
A 'bottle' may be reusable steel or single-use PET; the user must confirm.
A photo cannot establish lifecycle emissions, actual electricity use, product composition, or recyclability in every location.
Visible object counts and categories do not indicate whether a space is environmentally good or bad.
The detector may miss objects or misclassify them; confidence is a model score, not a probability that the sustainability guidance applies.

bottle.guidance: Confirm whether this is a reusable bottle or a single-use container. The photo cannot determine its material or recyclability.

cup.guidance: Confirm reusable versus disposable. The photo cannot establish cup material or how often it is reused.

wine glass.guidance: Confirm that this is durable glassware; object detection alone cannot establish reuse.

bowl.guidance: Confirm whether this is reusable crockery; the photo cannot establish its material or use.

fork.guidance: Confirm metal versus single-use cutlery; material cannot be inferred from this image.

knife.guidance: Confirm metal versus single-use cutlery; material cannot be inferred from this image.

spoon.guidance: Confirm metal versus single-use cutlery; material cannot be inferred from this image.

laptop.guidance: A photo cannot show actual electricity use or efficiency. Check measured use and product labels when relevant.

cell phone.guidance: Confirm the device and its condition. Repair and life extension may be considered; the image does not show composition or energy use.

tv.guidance: Do not infer energy use or star rating from appearance; consult its label or measured consumption.

remote.guidance: Maintain and repair electronics where practical; the image does not establish their efficiency.

keyboard.guidance: Maintain or repair electronics where practical; the image does not establish material or energy use.

mouse.guidance: Maintain or repair electronics where practical; the image does not establish material or energy use.

microwave.guidance: A photo cannot show energy consumption. If replacing, compare verified BEE star labels and consider repair first.

oven.guidance: Do not infer efficiency from appearance. Confirm the appliance and check its label or measured use.

toaster.guidance: Repair if practical; do not infer efficiency from its appearance.

refrigerator.guidance: Confirm its model and BEE star rating from the nameplate; neither is readable from this image.

sink.guidance: Check for dripping taps. Flow rate cannot be measured from a photo.

book.guidance: Reuse or share books; local paper recycling rules vary.

vase.guidance: Durable household items: maintain and reuse.

potted plant.guidance: Indoor plants do not offset household emissions. They may support wellbeing; watering still uses water.

chair.guidance: Repair before replacement when practical and safe; the image does not establish condition.

couch.guidance: Consider repair, reupholstery, or donation only after confirming condition and local options.

bed.guidance: Confirm condition before considering repair or disposal; local bulky-waste rules vary.

dining table.guidance: Consider repair before replacement after confirming the item's condition.

backpack.guidance: Repair where practical; textile reuse and recycling options vary locally.

handbag.guidance: Repair or reuse where practical; material and condition cannot be assessed from the photo.

suitcase.guidance: Repair where practical; material and condition cannot be assessed from the photo.

umbrella.guidance: Repair where practical; material and condition cannot be assessed from the photo.

bicycle.guidance: A visible bicycle does not establish travel habits, route safety, or avoided emissions.

motorcycle.guidance: Fuel use and travel patterns cannot be measured from a photo.

car.guidance: A vehicle photo cannot establish fuel use, distance, occupancy, or emissions. Compare actual trips and available alternatives.

bus.guidance: A bus photo does not establish regular travel or displaced vehicle trips.

train.guidance: A train photo does not establish regular travel or avoided emissions.

tvmonitor.guidance: Treat as a display device; efficiency is not visible.
